 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1555637023" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1555637023" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h1 class="text-align-center"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">ROOMS</span></h1> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1243236030" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1243236030"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">The Laid-back Luxury of Todo Bien</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmRespRow u_1530765397" id="1530765397"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1596310420"> <div class="u_1702951051 dmRespCol small-12 large-7 medium-7" id="1702951051"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1944837991" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7);">Casita Suite</span></h2> 
</div> 
 <a data-display-type="block" class="u_1904861625 align-center dmButtonLink dmWidget dmWwr default dmOnlyButton dmDefaultGradient flexButton" file="false" href="https://hotels.cloudbeds.com/reservation/5r6IWY" data-element-type="dButtonLinkId" id="1904861625" target="_blank"> <span class="iconBg" aria-hidden="true" id="1005024878"> <span class="icon hasFontIcon icon-star" id="1588631672"></span> 
</span> 
 <span class="text" id="1413640711">CHECK AVAILABILITY</span> 
</a> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1961152409 dmRespCol small-12 large-5 medium-5" id="1961152409"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1570619281" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">A private oceanfront retreat for couples or solo travelers seeking comfort, calm, privacy, and one of the finest views on the planet. On cool evenings, unwind under the stars in your private hot tub or gather around your outdoor fireplace as you watch the moon rise across the bay. In warmer months, refresh yourself in the cold-dipping pool after a day on the water.</span> 
</span></p><p style="line-height: 0.5;"><br/></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Enjoy the fully equipped kitchen or opt for hotel room service. Just steps from the beach, the Casita is completely private while remaining effortlessly connected to all hotel amenities.</span> 
</span></p><p style="line-height: 0.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><span class="ql-cursor">﻿</span></span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">You&rsquo;ll never want to leave.</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div>

 <div class="dmRespRow u_1205326321" id="1205326321"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1226726030"> <div class="u_1585078027 dmRespCol small-12 large-7 medium-7" id="1585078027"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1493902054" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7);">Poseidon Suite</span></h2> 
</div> 
 <a data-display-type="block" class="u_1494810970 align-center dmButtonLink dmWidget dmWwr default dmOnlyButton dmDefaultGradient flexButton" file="false" href="https://hotels.cloudbeds.com/reservation/5r6IWY" data-element-type="dButtonLinkId" id="1494810970" target="_blank"> <span class="iconBg" aria-hidden="true" id="1392327876"> <span class="icon hasFontIcon icon-star" id="1287217005"></span> 
</span> 
 <span class="text" id="1660286960">CHECK AVAILABILITY</span> 
</a> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1051122604 dmRespCol small-12 large-5 medium-5" id="1051122604"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1054108186" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial; font-style: normal;">Sometimes also called &ldquo;the penthouse&quot;, The Poseidon Suite sits above the Todo Bien pools, offering sweeping views of La Ventana Bay and Isla Cerralvo - complete with indoor and outdoor living rooms, TV, kitchenette and private fire pit. Without a doubt, one of the finest spots in La Ventana - the perfect space for a romantic vacation or long-term stay.</span></p><p style="line-height: 2;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div>

This room offers incredible sweeping water and island views.</span></p><p style="line-height: 2;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div>
